name: Fear, and Loathing in Las Vegas
description: {{nihongo|'''Fear, and Loathing in Las Vegas'''|フィアー・アンド・ロージング・イン・ラスベガス|Fiā ando Rōjingu in Rasu Begasu|lead=yes}} is a Japanese [[electronicore]] band from [[Kobe]] that was formed in summer 2008. The band currently consists of vocalist So, keyboardist Minami, guitarist Taiki, drummer Tomonori, and bassist Tetsuya. They are best known for their heavy use of [[vocoder]] and synthesizer blended with [[emo]]/[[metalcore]] music and rave beats.
